execution: Exact original wrapper AST; real CPU tensors and actual Torch reshape; Triton kernel launch spy.

source_findings.detail: stride_kcx is passed by both layout branches but not read by kernel body; a last-dimension stride of 2 still addresses lane+1 instead of lane+2.
Only lengths.shape[0] is checked; kernel addresses seq_lengths+seq and does not receive a length stride. Noncontiguous or extra-dimensional lengths can pass host checks.
Old-layout branch accepts rank5 caches and mismatched head counts; model must retain actual shape[-2], stride(2), stride(3) rather than imposing new-layout assertions.
No positive-n check. n=0 produces grid dimension0; negative n reaches negative grid tuple in spy. Actual Triton launch behavior is not exercised.
head_dim=129 requests num_warps8 and KCACHE_X129; host accepts it although original tl.arange requires a power-of-two width.

limitations: No native launch or CUDA allocator/device behavior validated.
Finite probes do not prove complete Torch reshape refinement.
Input tensor offsets in this probe are zero; arbitrary storage-base alias/offset mapping remains a native obligation.
